reviews.title: Good stand
reviews.comment: I purchased the Elgato Wave 3, so naturally wanted to get this arm stand for it. It clamps onto my desk and doesn't loosen up. Works nicely overall. I've encountered no issues with it and am happy with this product. It has a good range of flexibility and can even reach to my head height if I decide to record while standing up.
reviews.author: Ben

reviews.title: I couldn't bring myself to do more than 4 stars
reviews.comment: I really am not sure now why I thought this would be a great investment. It's of decent quality but, of the two arms that we have, these do not properly grip the desks. The surfaces are clean, and it doesn't matter how tightly you turn them, they will gravitate to one side eventually. I hardly use mine and have had to resort to putting foam under it to get it to stay still and not dig into my desk underneath. My son uses his all day and night long and somehow his stays better but still wobbles. A wider, more low profile base would improve this greatly.
reviews.author: KeishaJ

reviews.title: Quality
reviews.comment: Very good build quality. Strong springs and easy to move around after setup. Installing Wave 3 was also easy.
reviews.author: Johan van der Westhuizen
